description: An arbitrary propositional theory \(\Gamma\) is consistent in the specified classical natural-deduction calculus if and only if \(\Gamma\) is satisfiable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.consistency_iff_satisfiable.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.TheoryConsistent Γ ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.TheorySatisfiable Γ
